notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: The Headquarters level is very difficult. Congrats to all who have beat it. However with this patch I made it slightly easier (not too much).

notes.title: Minor adjustments for VR-version
notes.notes:
-Many people have requested an increase to walking speed so I increased it.
-Going trough doorways is now easier in the second level.
-People were saying it's too dark. It's a little less dark now.
-The ending/game over screen is no longer bugged.

notes.title: New level for the VR-version. Non-VR-version now available on macOS & linux!
notes.notes:
The title says it all. 
-VR-version finally gets the the new level (The Headquarters). 
-Non-VR-version is now available on macOS and linux/steamOS
-VR-version is only for windows.

notes.title: NEW LEVEL!
notes.notes: A second level (The Headquarters) has been added to the non-VR -version of the game. VR-version will get the new level later. A secret has also been added. Brightness-slider has also been added to the pause menu and the white fog effect has been removed from the first level. Have fun spotting anomalies!

notes.title: Patch notes.
notes.notes:
- Fixed some minor anomaly-reporting difficulties.
- Bookshelf in the study has been replaced.
- VR walk speed has been slightly increased.
- Alternative pause button (VR) has been added. Makes pausing the game easier on Index, Vive ect.
- The footstool in the bedroom will no longer block movement to the right side of the room in the non-VR -version.

notes.title: The launch-issue with the VR-version has been fixed!
notes.notes: The VR-version should work now. Let me know if you encounter any issues.
